description:
Purpose in Every Position

Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platform™, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.

Where Your Work Moves the Needle.

At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

Pebl is looking for a Director, Legal to lead our Legal team in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. This full-time, remote-based position reports to the Chief People and Legal Officer and will set the direction for labor and employment-related legal matters across the region. The Director will lead a small team, advise senior leaders and customers, and partner cross-functionally and with our customer-facing teams to deliver practical, compliant solutions at speed.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned employment lawyer with deep experience across multiple APAC jurisdictions, ideally in an EoR or global employment environment. You make sound, high-stakes decisions, develop the lawyers on your team, and build alignment with executives and customers, even in sensitive situations. You are pragmatic, business-minded, collaborative, and self-directed, and you see legal counsel as a way to help the business move faster.

This is a fully remote position

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Set the legal strategy for APAC labor and employment-related matters, aligned with and help shape regional and global plans alongside senior leaders.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the APAC legal team, including setting goals, managing performance, and building a pipeline of legal talent.

  • Serve as the final decision-maker on complex and high-risk employment matters across APAC, including employment agreements, involuntary exits, disputes, and risk mitigation.

  • Own the APAC employment compliance and risk management framework, anticipating legislative and regulatory change and translating it into practical policies, templates, and playbooks.

  • Advise and influence executives and senior leaders on high-stakes matters, building alignment in sensitive situations.

  • Manage the outside counsel network and local partners that support Pebl’s EoR operations across APAC, including selection, quality, and spend.

  • Expand legal coverage across APAC jurisdictions as the business grows, and partner with the Chief People and Legal Officer on global legal priorities.

Let's Connect If You:

  • LL.B., LL.M., J.D., or an equivalent degree, and [qualification to practice in at least one APAC jurisdiction].

  • 10+ years of legal experience focused on employment law, in private practice, in-house, or both, including 8+ years leading legal teams or managing lawyers.

  • Experience leading and developing lawyers at multiple levels.

  • Experience advising on employment matters across multiple APAC jurisdictions.

  • Experience in an EoR, PEO, or global employment services environment.

  • Proven ability to manage a broad portfolio of matters, set priorities, and deliver practical, compliant solutions at speed.

  • Strong judgment, with a track record of making and owning high-stakes decisions and escalating appropriately.

  • Ability to explain complex legal topics clearly to customers and build trust with senior customer stakeholders.

  • Experience managing outside counsel and legal budgets.

  • Demonstrate ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve legal research, drafting, workflow efficiency, and knowledge management, with sound judgment around confidentiality, accuracy, and human review.

  • Business proficiency in English.

  • Ability to adapt to differing local requirements across the region.

Our Commitment to You

At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge.

  • Parental Leave – Support for growing families.

  • Health and Dental Insurance – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.

  • Retirement Savings + Employee Incentive Plan – Plan for the future while sharing our success.

Please visit our career page for more information.

Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.
